description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 函数计算调用时间，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the Function Compute is called. The format is **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

description.zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID。
description.en: The trace ID of the invocation request of Function Compute.
The version or alias of the service.

descriptions.zh: 配置中的StatefulAsyncInvocation即为异步任务的配置项。当StatefulAsyncInvocation取值为true时，代表您已开启异步任务，所有的异步调用将变为异步任务模式。
descriptions.en: StatefulAsyncInvocation indicates whether the asynchronous task feature is enabled. If the value of StatefulAsyncInvocation is true, the asynchronous task feature is enabled. All asynchronous invocations change to asynchronous task mode.
